# Acme pilot — prep

## People
- Dana Ruiz — VP Operations at Acme, economic buyer. Cares about warehouse pick accuracy.
- Leo Park — Dana's analyst, ran the pilot dashboards.

## Pilot terms (signed 2026-08-04)
- 60-day pilot across 2 warehouses (Reno, Dallas).
- Success criteria agreed: pick accuracy from 96.1% to 98.5%, and onboarding time per picker under 3 days.
- Price after pilot: $42k/year for both sites; Dana asked for a 3-site quote before.

## Known issues
- Dallas Wi-Fi dropouts in aisles 30-38 caused scanner sync failures in week 2 (ticket ACM-118, fixed 2026-09-02).
- Reno switched shift schedules in week 5 — new pickers joined mid-pilot.

## What I want from this call
- Confirm whether the success criteria were met.
- Get a decision timeline and who else signs off (procurement?).

# acme-pilot: memory
_Updated 2026-10-20 · 2 calls folded in_

## In one line
Pilot is positive but short of the agreed bar in Dallas; Dana needs a three-site cost quote before her Sep 14 budget review to take it to procurement and the CFO.

## People
- **Dana Ruiz**, VP Operations, economic buyer. Wants numbers, prefers email follow-ups, decides with procurement and the CFO.
- **Leo Park**, Dana's analyst. Owns the pilot dashboard; the source of every metric.

## Facts and numbers
- Success criteria: pick accuracy 96.1% → 98.5%, onboarding under 3 days per picker (signed 2026-08-04).
- Reno accuracy ~98%, Dallas ~97% (2026-10-20).
- Reno onboarding for new pickers ~1 week, early group faster (2026-10-20).
- Price after pilot: $42k/year for two sites (2026-08-04).

## Decisions so far
- Pilot runs 60 days across Reno and Dallas (2026-08-04).

## Open loops
- [ ] ME: send three-site cost quote, before Dana's budget review on Sep 14.
- [ ] ME: timeline for going live in the third warehouse if they say yes in November.
- [ ] ME: explain why later Reno pickers onboarded slower (shift change in week 5?).

## What changed
- Dallas scanner sync: failing in week 2 → fixed 2026-09-02 (ACM-118). Dana's team still worries it will recur.

## Timeline
- 2026-10-20 · Acme pilot review · Positive, but CFO needs three-site cost first.
- 2026-09-15 · Mid-pilot check-in · Dallas sync fix confirmed, Leo to share dashboard.

## Lessons for the next call
- Open with the success criteria and the gap (98.5% target vs ~97% in Dallas) before Dana raises it.
- Bring ACM-118 and the fix date: "will it happen again?" came up twice.
- Have the three-site price ready; the CFO question is predictable.
